Appearance:
 Shri Abhinav Dubey - Advocate for the applicant.
Ms. Ekta Gupta - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/Stat  ORDER
This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

2. The applicant is in custody since 07.05.2024 in connection with Crime No.144/2024 registered at P.S.-Pipariya, District- Narmdapuram (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366,
376(2)(n) of IPC and 5/6 of POCSO Act.

3. As per the prosecution story, allegations against the present applicant are that on 01.08.2024, in the night, applicant forcibly took away prosecutrtix aged 17 years from her house and thereafter established physical relation with prosecutrix against her will.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that story as narrated by the prosecutrix is highly unnatural and improbable.
It is not possible to forcibly took away prosecutrix from her house.
There is nothing on record to show that prosecutrix offered any resistance to the appellant.
It is also urged that prosecutrix did not inform anyone on the way when she was being taken forcibly against her NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:46012 2 MCRC-38094-2024 will.
It is a case of consent.
Charge sheet has already been filed.
Prosecutrix has been examined.
He further submits that the trial of the case will take considerable time.

Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant Rahul @ Chandrashekhar Singh Gujar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189148451/
1 be released on bail pending the trial.

sentences.text: 5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.
6. In view of over all facts and circumstances of the case and evidence on record, without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently,
bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant-Rahul @ Chandrashekhar Singh Gujar be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE L.R. NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:46012 3 MCRC-38094-2024 Rahul @ Chandrashekhar Singh Gujar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189148451/
